Subject: RE: Intro: Redwood Inference + HealthSync — VP intro (missed today)

Hi Samantha,

We missed the VP at 10:00 — no problem, I wanted to share a short recap from what I planned to cover so their time is efficient when we reconvene.

Recap (2 min read):
- Redwood provides a unified inference runtime for hosted/dedicated/private deployments to balance latency, cost, and compliance.
- Typical wins we see for healthtech: 2–4x cost reduction on heavy embedding/query workloads via smart batching + prefix caching; sub-200ms P95 on short chat flows with dedicated capacity.
- Security: optional VPC/private deployments, KMS integration, and audit logs suitable for SOC 2 needs.

Attached the one-pager and the mutual-action-plan I mentioned.

Would you be able to requeue a 20-min slot next week that works for the VP? I can also do a 10-minute pre-brief with Tom or whoever will prepare the VP. Proposed times (PT):
- Tue 2027-04-20 9:30–9:50
- Tue 2027-04-20 11:00–11:20
- Wed 2027-04-21 14:00–14:20

If none of those work, please propose two 20-min windows and I'll prioritize.

Thanks, and apologies if that original invite collided with an urgent item — happy to be flexible.

Best,
Diego
